name: Piecewise Constant Approximation Inverse
aliases: Inverse CDF with Piecewise Constant Density
definition: An explicit formula to solve for time $t$ given a target integral value $y$, assuming density $ho_r$ is constant within each sample interval $[t_{j-1}, t_j]$.
summary: Piecewise Constant Approximation Inverse computes ray parameters for uniform density sampling using a closed-form linear solution, offering computational efficiency over piecewise linear methods at the cost of accuracy for rapidly varying density fields.
